title: replicate mock
category: sub-skill of image-to-react · pixel, hex & 3-bucket classifier
short_summary: extracts exact hex tokens, pixel measurements, and classifies dom native-code vs. crisp-media vs. upscale-queue crops (adapted with credit from manasababu).
when_to_use: use in stage 1a of jason-dev-agent to sample exact hex palettes, build native html/css/svg ui, and isolate true photographic crops.
summary: Converts UI screenshots and design mockups into pixel-perfect, functioning prototypes using native HTML/CSS and interactive frontend rendering. Enforces bit-for-bit asset extraction for photographs/complex images, perfect text reconstruction, exact typography/hex colors, and vector-to-vector matching with zero hallucination and zero omission. Use when asked to implement a UI mockup, convert a screenshot to code, replicate a design, or build a functioning frontend prototype from an image. Don't use for general web scraping without a design mockup or for backend logic implementation.
